about: The recommended-model table in Settings > Model (app/model_setup.py). One row per memory size: the smallest memory (GB) the row needs, the Ollama model name the one-click download pulls, its download size, and whether this project has tested it, and whether it is available yet. Every row is listed and downloadable; the row that fits this computer's memory best carries the "Recommended for your computer" badge. A row may still be marked "available": false to make it a placeholder with no download (none is today).
